title: Shared Free Time
statement: Two coworkers each list their free slots as [start, end], sorted and not overlapping within each list. Return every slot when both are free (the overlaps of the two lists), in order. Slots that meet only at a single moment count, as [t, t].

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers over both sorted lists
keyPoints: The overlap of two slots is [max of starts, min of ends] if it is not empty
Advance the pointer whose slot ends first

hints: When do two slots overlap, and what is the overlap?
lo = max(starts), hi = min(ends); they overlap when lo <= hi.
Two pointers; after recording an overlap, move past the slot that ends first.
